verdict.rationale: Lithic is clearly API-first. Documented API surfaces cover card creation, authorization rules at program, account and card level, ASA decisioning, webhooks and event replay through the Events API, KYC account-holder creation, disputes, sandbox simulation and dated API versioning, and the MCP server can execute live API requests. However, no evidence explicitly states that the API matches the dashboard feature-for-feature, so full UI parity is only implied. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, evidence about dashboard-only features (e.g., team/user management, reporting), a publicly retrievable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
